name: citere-site
description: Citere public website - public evidence base for AI chatbot monitoring

scripts.all: npm run validate && npm run build && npm run check && npm run lighthouse
scripts.build:pages: node scripts/clean.mjs && node scripts/with-env.mjs PATH_PREFIX=/citere-site/ CANONICAL_URL=https://vit-koval.github.io/citere-site -- eleventy
scripts.lighthouse: node scripts/with-env.mjs PATH_PREFIX=/ CANONICAL_URL=https://vit-koval.github.io/citere-site -- eleventy --output=_site-lighthouse && lhci autorun --config=lighthouserc.json
